title: Make ClickStack and Langfuse required, not optional, across docs and config
context: ClickStack and Langfuse are the whole point of this demo (correlated telemetry across both backends), but the repo currently treats both as optional add-ons: README.md says 'Both destinations are external and both are optional, on both targets'; the EKS target lets Langfuse silently degrade to none; the laptop/Compose target lets both ClickStack and Langfuse silently degrade to none; and .env.example calls the whole block 'Optional existing backends'. This plan flips the framing and the enforcement: config-time preflight refuses to run without both configured, on both targets, and the docs are reworded to match. Decided in clarify: (1) enforcement lives at the CLI/config layer (demo.py config/up/eks apply/eks deploy), not inside the running agent/collector processes; (2) Langfuse's existing outage-resilience fallback (60s cache, bundled-prompt fallback on a live API failure once configured) is a different concern from 'is it configured at all' and stays as-is.
constraints: Keep the Langfuse runtime outage fallback (60s cache, bundled-prompt fallback on a live 404/error once Langfuse IS configured) -- only the initial "configured at all" check becomes mandatory, not resilience to a transient outage.
Enforce configuration only via CLI/config-time preflight (demo.py config/up/eks apply/eks deploy) -- do not add startup checks inside the agent/collector container processes themselves.
Leave deploy/eks/k8s manifests' `optional: true` secretKeyRef references as-is (defense-in-depth); this cycle enforces at the CLI/.env layer, not by removing manifest-level optionality.

tests/test_docs.py::test_the_readme_keeps_its_outline is currently failing due to the user's own unrelated in-progress README.md edits (removed the ECR-consolidation warning, the Validated table, and the Langfuse skill integration review section) -- pre-existing and out of scope; do not fix it by restoring those sections.

eks deploy refuses -- via the load_langfuse_env die -- before creating any Kubernetes Secret when Langfuse is unconfigured, verified by a test that redirects an .env with the Langfuse keys blank/absent and asserts the CLI dies with a message naming the missing keys.
